answer.explanation: Every Compression invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET=missing-bucket-lambda-rca (about 410 error records from 21:37 to 21:47). The live OUTPUT_BUCKET matches the template, and the template hardcodes that literal while the other functions reference the output bucket via !Ref. The value was deployed at 21:37:37Z, just before the window. The IAM role grants PutObject on the real output bucket, so the failure is a bad bucket name, not a permission issue. The fault originates in the committed template, so the layer is IAC; the live env var is the deployed symptom.
